title: Yosemite 3 Day Tour from Los Angeles and Orange County
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Yosemite National Park 3-Day Adventure from Orange County & Los Angeles

Available Dates: July 11–13, July 24–26, Aug 7–9, Aug 14–16, Sept 4–6, Sept 11–13, Oct 9–11, and Oct 16–18. Private departures are available upon request—please contact the operator directly.

Discover the beauty of Yosemite National Park on this immersive 3-day small-group adventure. Explore iconic landmarks including Tunnel View, Yosemite Valley, Glacier Point, El Capitan, Half Dome, Bridalveil Fall, and the giant sequoias of Mariposa Grove.

Choose between a Camping Experience beside the river or a Hotel Experience in nearby accommodations. Both options share the same activities, meals, and evening gatherings.

Enjoy guided hikes, learn about Yosemite's wildlife and geology, relax around the campfire with s'mores, and connect with fellow travelers in a group of just 6–14 guests.

Includes: Transportation, Yosemite entrance fees, 5 meals, guided activities, and camping equipment for camping guests.
